correctness.rationale: The order-standardization to at most 2*4=8 distinct endpoints preserves all queried inversion labels; the converse increasing-block inflation inserts arbitrary unqueried positions while preserving 321 avoidance. Explicit label patterns for each forbidden configuration give a descending-triple or cyclic-inequality obstruction. An independent complete brute-force implementation enumerated all 321-avoiders (Catalan 1430 at n8) and every support of 0..4 among 28 possible comparisons, finding equivalence with all listed forbidden inclusions. At n8 it independently reproduced shattered counts (1,28,322,1820,4977) and minimal type counts (56,210,56); it passed every n=1..8. The all-n conclusion rests on the analytic inflation reduction, not a finite extrapolation. Circuit elimination fails for the two overlapping minimal two-query chains.
